document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
As you wander alone along the bank of the river, a thin drizzle 
chills you. You notice a cave opening and duck into it for shelter.

You stop short one pace in. The stench coming out of the cave 
is overpowering. You sense heavy breathing in the darkness. 
Suddenly the inhabitants step into the gray light.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 426.
